g.title: cluster_InstanceGroupZone.7
g.text: Node Pool Apps (cluster autoscaler, 1 to 5 nodes per zone)

g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Google Cloud GKE microservices with Private Service Connect

g.title: None.None.Node.3
g.text: Customers connect to the global HTTPS load balancer
The URL map routes to the storefront backend, where Cloud Armor filters attacks
The load balancer sends the request to storefront pods on GKE nodes in three zones
The pods save the order to Cloud SQL through its Private Service Connect endpoint
and publish an order event to Pub/Sub through the endpoint for Google APIs
The event triggers the Cloud Run fulfilment service
which records the shipment in Firestore
A BigQuery subscription streams every order into the sales dataset
The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler adds storefront replicas when average CPU passes 70%
Replicas that do not fit make the cluster autoscaler add nodes to the pool in that zone, up to five per zone, and remove idle ones
